description.en: Shorthand for CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_Animal with both _no_bustup and _shadow forced to true — creates a shadow-casting, low-detail animal-type NPC model without a bustup portrait.
Name to assign the created model.
NPC number used to build the model's file path.
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a shadow-casting animal-type NPC model without a bustup portrait
local hAnimalL = CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_AnimalNoBustup_Shadow("animalL", 5);
